cii.notes: Phase 2 (spring 2026 - spring 2028) is actively re-examining the CII metric itself, including exclusion of idle/port-waiting fuel (PLAN.md §7.6). CII has no direct financial penalty; its consequence is a SEEMP Part III corrective-action-plan obligation (PLAN.md §3.6) — see implied_price.py:cii_implied_price for how that is converted onto a $/tCO2e axis.

citations: Regulation (EU) 2023/1805 (FuelEU Maritime) — Article 2(1) scope; Articles 20-21 banking, borrowing, pooling

fuel_eu.status: VERIFIED_PER_DOCUMENT (reduction_schedule and penalty formula excepted — see notes)
fuel_eu.scope: 100% of energy on voyages between EU/EEA ports and at berth in EU/EEA ports; 50% on voyages between an EU/EEA port and a third-country port; ships >=5000 GT
fuel_eu.reduction_schedule_status: NOT_IN_PROJECT_DOCUMENT — PLAN.md references 'its reduction schedule' without stating year-by-year percentages. Must be pulled from Regulation (EU) 2023/1805 Annex I before Phase 3/4 code depends on exact yearly targets.

penalty_formula.status: SECONDARY_SOURCE — Annex IV Part B text itself was not retrievable in this session (EUR-Lex PDF did not extract cleanly); the formula below is reconstructed from secondary summaries and should be cross-checked against the primary regulation text before it gates any real compliance-ledger number (Phase 4).
penalty_formula.penalty_eur: abs(compliance_balance_gco2eq) / (ghg_intensity_actual_gco2e_per_mj * vlsfo_energy_density_mj_per_tonne) * penalty_rate_eur_per_tonne_vlsfoeq, applied only when compliance_balance_gco2eq < 0
penalty_formula.consecutive_deficit_multiplier: 1 + (n - 1) / 10, where n = number of consecutive reporting periods in deficit for that ship

banking.rule: surplus carries forward; a banked surplus does not expire

pooling.enforcement_note: Enforced exactly at the SMC particle level per docs/DESIGN_NOTE_POOLING.md §2B, never on the tensor bond as source of truth.

citations: IMO Net-Zero Framework — official FAQ (surplus units, remedial units, two-tier pricing)

nzf.status: VERIFIED_PER_DOCUMENT — this is the 'approved text' position; adoption itself is pending the October 2026 IMO session (see scenarios.json for the K=5 outcomes modelled)
nzf.scope: ships below/above the direct compliance target; global

citations: Directive 2003/87/EC as amended for maritime — scope, phase-in schedule, voyage-share rules

eu_ets.status: VERIFIED_PER_DOCUMENT (EUA spot price excepted — see below; PLAN.md §11.1 item 8 flags this and the phase-in percentages as 'the least stable numbers in the document')
eu_ets.scope: cargo and passenger ships >=5000 GT, regardless of flag, since 1 January 2024
eu_ets.eua_spot_price_status: TARGET — a genuine market price, not fabricated here. Must be pulled live and re-verified immediately before submission per PLAN.md §11.1 item 8 and §11.7.
eu_ets.stacking_note: FuelEU and EU ETS are separate instruments that stack (PLAN.md §3.2): a vessel calling at an EU port owes both, independently, on overlapping but not identical voyage-share definitions. The compliance ledger must keep them as separate line items rather than netting them.
